messages:
elaine: quick triage for Novus-Mini v2.7B bring-up. License snippet: 'Non-Commercial use only; Model weights and modified binaries may not be redistributed for commercial purposes; Attribution must be displayed where model outputs are shown.' Can we: (1) ship quantized weights to Dedicated customers? (2) serve embeddings to paying customers? (3) show attribution in UI — suggested wording?
jamal (legal): initial read: NC + no-redistribution blocks commercial hosting and handing out quantized binaries. Need full license link.
mika: infra note: if we never hand over a quantized file and only run inference, that feels less like redistribution, but NC may still forbid commercial use.
elaine: link: https://example.org/novus-mini/LICENSE
jamal (legal): with that wording: Hosted paid inference = disallowed. Shipping quantized files = redistribution = disallowed. BYOW private where customer supplies original weights and we only orchestrate = likely OK with attestation.
tom-infra: we can gate the model on Hosted via feature flag and reuse BYOW onboarding flow with an attestation and hash check.
mika: embeddings are risky; license ties attribution to outputs — treat embeddings for paying customers as prohibited until legal confirms.
jamal (legal): conservative recommendation: 1) don't enable on Hosted for paid customers; 2) only BYOW private deployments with attestation; 3) request a commercial license or redistribution carve-out from upstream. For attribution show: 'Powered by Novus-Mini v2.7B — License: https://example.org/novus-mini/LICENSE' near outputs and in API docs/response headers. I'll draft a short guidance blurb by EOD.
opsbot: tag added: #legal-triage :white_check_mark:
elaine: thanks — pausing commercial evals and tagging product to block Hosted rollout until legal signs off.
